cards.title: Laurent bulk Hamiltonians, winding, and finite domain-wall ring

checks.detail: All coefficients and N1:N2:N3=58:41:87 are stated in Fig. 2 and Eqs. (3)-(5).
Applying the homogeneous row stencil to psi_x=beta^x returns h_alpha(beta) psi_x exactly.
The domain-weighted decay rates satisfy the closed-ring zero-growth constraint.

open_questions: The finite cross-interface stencil is not specified; the local row/domain stencil is disclosed and tested.

cards.title: Constrained Ronkin function in root/Jensen form

checks.detail: Definition, global constraint, and Jensen form are explicit in SIV.
Between adjacent log-root moduli, dR/dmu=-s+l equals the point-gap winding.
The minimum is evaluated over all pairwise breakpoint intersections of the convex piecewise-linear objective.

cards.title: Case-I standing and Case-II traveling GBZ conditions

checks.detail: All ordered-root indices and lambda_0/lambda_1 equations are explicit for the 2/3/4-root example.
lambda_1-lambda_0 is a positive weighted sum of adjacent ordered-root gaps.
Opening the ring removes adjacent-sector degeneracy and leaves only individual-domain equal-modulus conditions.

open_questions: The exact E1-E3 samples used for Fig. 3(b-d) are not reported.

checks.detail: The flux-modified hopping and log-determinant winding are explicit.
Unwrapped determinant phase divided by 2pi is rounded only after a closed 0-to-2pi loop and residual checking.

cards.title: Spectral-potential density of states

checks.detail: Both spectral potentials and rho=(1/2pi) Delta_E Phi are explicit.
The diagonalization potential uses the stated 1/N eigenvalue normalization.
The same Cartesian grid and central-difference Laplacian are used for both panels.

open_questions: The source does not report the energy-grid extent or spacing; a converged grid is declared in config.

checks.detail: The opened 3|1 interface and union of constituent OBC spectra are explicit.
In the thermodynamic root condition only the w=0 equal-modulus sector survives.
